metrics.result: Characterised as mixed and schedule-sensitive rather than uniform. Relevant here because this baseline routes every transformer matrix to Muon, so any mechanism that assumes an Adam-style per-channel preconditioner may not compose with it.

locators.excerpt: Recently, Muon has gained substantial attention as an appealing alternative to Adam-like optimizers, with many works highlighting its advantages through spectral normalization and improved conditioning. Yet this positive theoretical narrative contrasts with its empirical performance in large language model (LLM) training, where Muon's gains over Adam/AdamW are often mixed, schedule-sensitive, and not uniformly superior.
